start: Workout open with Treadmill (library exercise) logged by time, set 1 not done

user_sees: Two small boxes, one labelled 'km/h' and one '% incline', lined up under the set's own boxes
must_not: Boxes filled with a guess the member never typed

steps.action: Type 8.5 in km/h and 6 in % incline, then tick the set
user_sees: The boxes keep 8.5 and 6; the set is ticked
must_not: The values cleared by the tick

steps.action: Finish and open the workout in History

start: Workout with a bike, a rower and own exercises

steps.action: Look under a set of Exercise Bike, Elliptical, Stair climber or Rower
must_not: Speed or incline boxes on a bike

steps.action: Add an own exercise 'Treadmill walk' logged by time
user_sees: The km/h and % incline boxes show
must_not: No boxes for an own treadmill exercise logged by time

steps.action: Add an own 'Treadmill lunge' logged in kilos, and an 'Air bike'
must_not: Speed boxes under a weighted lunge

start: Treadmill set row with its two boxes

steps.action: Type letters or a minus sign
user_sees: Only digits, a point or a comma stay; at most 5 characters

steps.action: Type 45 in km/h (above the top of 40) and tick the set
user_sees: A clear sign that 45 is not kept
must_not: The box still showing 45 while the set is saved with no speed and no word to the member

steps.action: Clear the incline box and save
